scientific_integrity: The claim is proved by an all-parameter ordered-pair extension analysis; two independently implemented finite recurrences corroborate boundary calculations. Independent audit and exhaustive historical-priority verification are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to uncoloured adjacency logic of quantifier rank at most three on Cartesian products of two finite paths of lengths at least two. It does not address counting logic, named coordinates, higher quantifier rank or higher-dimensional products.
title: Five three-round theories of planar rectangular grid graphs
